scope.population: 2091 canonical TRAIN samples evaluated out of fold by kinship group
scope.test_policy: The 522 TEST samples remain blind and are neither emitted nor scored
scope.input: Fold-specific M25B 250 kb counts; no VCF reread and no new MAC/MAF/orientation fit
scope.claim_limit: Post-hoc sensitivity of the M25B representation; not biological validation, LAI improvement or an automatic NMF/AE trigger

adaptive_scheme.target: mean n_fold_train_rare_sites across informative 250 kb atoms, computed independently in each FIT
adaptive_scheme.algorithm: deterministic greedy grouping of contiguous 250 kb atoms; never cross structural zero-panel gaps; a dense atom is never split
adaptive_scheme.interpretation: Approximate balance of selected-site counts, not equal statistical information

overlap_policy.500_250: Evaluate offsets 0 and 250 kb as separate non-overlapping tilings
overlap_policy.1000_500: Evaluate offsets 0 and 500 kb as separate non-overlapping tilings
overlap_policy.prohibition: Never concatenate both phases or count them as independent evidence

aggregation.rule: Sum carrier, dosage, callable and missing counts, then recompute rates from summed numerators and denominators
aggregation.global_burden: Compute once from the original non-overlapping 250 kb atoms and reuse unchanged in every scheme
aggregation.gaps: Retain in the window catalogue, exclude zero-panel windows from PCA
aggregation.terminal_windows: Flag incomplete physical windows and report rank-1 sensitivity after excluding them

model.rank_policy: Rank 1 is the only capacity-matched primary comparison; ranks 2 and 4 are descriptive and cannot rescue rank 1
model.preprocessing: FIT-only centering without variance scaling; VALIDATION projection only
baselines: FIT OLS per derived window against the unchanged global carrier burden

metrics.primary: OOF skill = 1 - pooled SSE_PCA / pooled SSE_burden
metrics.weighted_sensitivity: Same ratio with n_callable_rare_sites weights; because call rate is near one, this mostly tests selected-site-count weighting
metrics.uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap replicates over split_group_key, stratified by outer fold; never bootstrap windows
diagnostics: PC score R2 with burden, Q, cohort and callability
rank-1 contribution by derived window versus selected-site count
score-subspace concordance across scales on the same held-out samples

decision_rule.stop: Keep STOP NMF/AE if any new core scheme has non-positive rank-1 skill in a fold, a bootstrap lower bound not above zero, persistently negative weighted skill, or if apparent support exists only at ranks 2/4 or in a shifted boundary phase
decision_rule.eligible_for_independent_confirmation: All new core schemes must be positive in 4/4 folds under unweighted and weighted metrics with bootstrap lower bounds above zero; boundary phases may only corroborate, never activate the rule
decision_rule.automatic_next_step: None. Even a pass requires Consejo POST and an independent confirmation design before NMF

council_pre.mathematical: GO as a small falsification sensitivity; rank 1 primary; paired group bootstrap; overlap split into phases
council_pre.rare_variants: GO to test the denominator/scale explanation; preserve gaps and ascertainment limits; no biological claim
council_pre.v02: GO before any NMF; aggregate existing counts; AE remains stopped
council_pre.synthesis: GO M25C only; no TEST, NMF, AE, LAI or autosomal scaling
